Distinct Subsequences exhaustive bounded oracle and edge fixture

claims.text: The Canonical owns two recoverable variants: both preserve LeetCode 115 and DP, while the expanded variant additionally requires the s/t count contract, time-complexity analysis and a space-optimized solution.
Official LeetCode 115 asks for the count of subsequences of s equal to t and promises the generated final answer fits a signed 32-bit integer.

The executable fixture verifies official examples, positional combinatorics, DP boundaries, saturation against enormous irrelevant intermediate prefix counts, exhaustive bounded binary cases against an independent recursive oracle, and defensive overflow handling outside the official final-answer promise.
